::: {.callout-note}
## Living catalog
This is a first-pass catalog; **as research continues, it expands**. Rows
carry the books they support so modules can link here stably. External URLs
are re-verified weekly by the repo's link-check CI, so link rot surfaces
automatically. To add a vendor: open a PR adding a row with book mapping and
a one-line relevance note (see [Research queue](#research-queue)).
:::

## How to use this catalog

Each track module points at a section here. Certifications are listed where
a role-based cert is the natural packaging of the training; free
learning-path options are noted where they exist. "Books" columns refer to
the [15-book corpus](index.html#the-15-book-corpus).

## Microsoft role-based training {#microsoft}

The AAN reference stack is Microsoft-heavy (Entra, Defender, Sentinel,
Purview, SQL Server, Azure networking), so Microsoft Learn role paths cover
the largest share of Track B. All Microsoft Learn content is free;
certification exams are paid.

| Certification / path | Exam | Books | Why it maps |
|---|---|---|---|
| [Azure Network Engineer Associate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/azure-network-engineer-associate/) | AZ-700 | 01, 02, 06 | Landing-zone networking, hybrid connectivity, private access — the Azure half of Books 01/02 |
| [Identity and Access Administrator](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/identity-and-access-administrator/) | SC-300 | 03, 04, 07 | Entra ID, conditional access, PIM — the identity spine of the corpus |
| [Security Operations Analyst](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/security-operations-analyst/) | SC-200 | 08, 10 | Sentinel + Defender XDR detection engineering (Book 10) and Defender VM (Book 08) |
| [Information Security Administrator](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/information-security-administrator/) | SC-401 | 09, 14 | Purview information protection, DLP, insider risk — Books 09/14 (successor to the retired SC-400) |
| [Azure Database Administrator Associate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/azure-database-administrator-associate/) | DP-300 | 04, 05, 06 | SQL Server / Azure SQL administration and authentication modernization |
| [Azure Security Engineer Associate](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/azure-security-engineer/) | AZ-500 | 07, 09 | Key Vault, CMK, platform security controls |
| [Cybersecurity Architect Expert](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/credentials/certifications/cybersecurity-architect-expert/) | SC-100 | 00, 13 | Whole-of-estate security architecture — the Book 00/13 leadership view |
| [Microsoft Learn training browser](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/training/) | — | all | Free modular learning paths under every product above; filter by product/role |

## Networking & DDI {#networking-ddi}

| Vendor | Offering | Books | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Cisco | [Cisco U.](https://u.cisco.com/) | 02 | SD-WAN (ENSDWI-track content) and enterprise routing paths; subscription with free tiers |
| Cisco | [Networking Academy](https://www.netacad.com/) | 02, 03 | Free foundational networking curriculum — good on-ramp for staff new to routing/switching |
| Juniper | [Juniper Networks](https://www.juniper.net/) | 02 | Alternative SD-WAN/routing curriculum where Juniper gear is in scope — navigate to Training & Certification (the Learning Portal host rejects automated checkers, so we link the stable root) |
| Infoblox | [Infoblox (Education Services)](https://www.infoblox.com/) | 01 | DDI (IPAM/DNS/DHCP) training for the Book 01 reference stack; navigate to Education/Training |
| BlueCat | [BlueCat Networks](https://bluecatnetworks.com/) | 01 | DDI training for the BlueCat migration path covered by the UIAO modernization adapter |
| CompTIA | [CompTIA (Network+, Security+)](https://www.comptia.org/) | 00–02 | Vendor-neutral baseline for staff entering the program without a networking background |

## Security operations {#security-operations}

| Vendor | Offering | Books | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Microsoft | SC-200 (see [§Microsoft](#microsoft)) | 08, 10 | Sentinel + Defender — the reference SIEM/XDR |
| Splunk | [Splunk training](https://www.splunk.com/en_us/training.html) | 10 | Portable SIEM/detection fundamentals; useful where agencies run mixed SIEM estates |
| Elastic | [Elastic training](https://www.elastic.co/training/) | 10 | Same rationale as Splunk — detection engineering concepts transfer |
| SANS | [SANS course catalog](https://www.sans.org/cyber-security-courses/) | 07, 08, 10 | Instructor-led depth (detection engineering, vuln management, privileged access); paid, GIAC-certifiable |
| ISC2 | [ISC2 certifications](https://www.isc2.org/) | 00, 13 | CISSP/CGRC-track governance framing for program leads |

## Federal & compliance {#federal-compliance}

| Source | Offering | Books | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| CISA | [CISA Learning](https://learning.cisa.gov/) | 08, 10, 11 | Free federal cyber training platform (successor to FedVTE) — incident response, vuln management, continuity |

| AWS | [AWS Skill Builder](https://skillbuilder.aws/) | 02 | Amazon Connect training for the contact-center exception in Book 02 (ADR-059 boundary exception) |

## Research queue {#research-queue}

Candidates identified but not yet researched/verified — next expansion pass:

- **Zscaler / Netskope academies** — additional SASE vendor coverage (Book 02).
- **ServiceNow Now Learning** — ITSM/CMDB integration training (evidence
  workflow side; the UIAO ServiceNow adapter).
- **Linux Foundation / OpenSSF** — SBOM and supply-chain courses for Book 12
  (BOD 26-04 pipeline).
- **ISACA** — CISM/CRISC governance tracks for Book 13.
- **IAPP** — CIPP/US privacy training for Book 14 (PT family).
- **Tenable / Qualys** — alternative vulnerability-management stacks (Book 08)
  for agencies not on Defender VM.
- **Instructor-led AAN cohort design** — whether any vendor offers
  application-aware-networking-specific curriculum worth licensing, vs.
  continuing to compose from the product training above.

### Row conventions for contributors

When adding a row: prefer the vendor's **stable training landing page** over
deep course URLs (deep links rot; the weekly link-check CI will catch it, but
stable landings avoid the churn), map to specific books, and say in one line
*why* it maps. Where a vendor's training portal sits behind a login, link the
public landing and note it.
